baseline.scope: Open-source Akaunting core routes and documented default features

coreCapabilities.title: Business dashboard
coreCapabilities.gap: Saved layouts, payables widgets, date filtering, and server-backed configurable widgets remain open.

contract.gap: Dashboard report contracts are not implemented.

api.gap: Server-authoritative dashboard APIs are not implemented.

web.gap: Existing UI coverage does not prove saved configurable widgets.

mobile.gap: Existing coverage does not prove configurable widgets or drill-down.

coreCapabilities.title: Products and services
coreCapabilities.gap: Media and per-item multiple-tax behavior remain open.

web.gap: No web E2E proves media or multiple taxes.

mobile.gap: Media and multiple taxes are absent.

coreCapabilities.title: Customers
coreCapabilities.gap: Contact people, addresses, statements, bulk mobility, and portal login remain open.

web.gap: No authenticated portal or statement E2E exists.

mobile.gap: Contacts, statements, and portal workflows are absent.

coreCapabilities.title: Sales invoices
coreCapabilities.gap: Lifecycle actions, attachments, line discounts and taxes, import/export, recurrence, and production delivery remain open.

web.gap: Open lifecycle and fidelity features are not covered.

mobile.gap: Open lifecycle and fidelity features are not implemented.

coreCapabilities.title: Vendors and bills
coreCapabilities.gap: Contacts/defaults, attachments, history, cancel/restore, split allocations, import/export, recurrence, and device QA remain open.

web.gap: Remaining lifecycle and data-mobility paths are not proved.

mobile.gap: Remaining lifecycle, attachment, import, and authenticated-device proof are open.

mobile.reason: Core parity is proved by the API and web workflow; mobile expense expansion is tracked by mobile coverage.

coreCapabilities.title: Payment/bank accounts
coreCapabilities.gap: Default payment account, statements, performance, bulk state changes, and a unified posting model remain open.

web.gap: No E2E proves statements, defaults, or bulk state changes.

mobile.gap: Statements, defaults, and bulk state changes are absent.

coreCapabilities.title: Banking transactions
coreCapabilities.gap: Manual CRUD, split allocations, document connections, attachments, duplicate, print/export, and mobile import remain open.

web.gap: Only import is covered; manual and connected transaction workflows are absent.

mobile.gap: Only imported history is covered.

coreCapabilities.title: Transfers
coreCapabilities.gap: No first-class transfer entity or atomic source/destination workflow exists.

api.gap: Atomic transfer integration coverage is missing.

web.gap: Transfer E2E is missing.

mobile.gap: Transfer workflow tests are missing.

mobile.reason: Akaunting core parity is proved on web; a native reconciliation workflow is tracked by mobile coverage.

coreCapabilities.title: Recurring activity
coreCapabilities.gap: No persisted recurrence templates, scheduler, occurrence idempotency, or run history exists.

web.gap: Recurring workflow E2E is missing.

mobile.gap: Recurring workflow tests are missing.

mobile.reason: Akaunting core parity is proved on web; native accounting administration is tracked by mobile coverage.

coreCapabilities.title: Financial reports
coreCapabilities.gap: Reports remain client-heavy and lack authoritative APIs, saved definitions, cash/accrual selection, exports, and complete drill-down.

api.gap: Authoritative report integration tests are missing.

web.gap: Existing UI coverage does not prove a server-authoritative ledger source.

mobile.gap: Native report workflows are absent.

coreCapabilities.title: Tax
coreCapabilities.gap: Reusable rate catalogue, compound and withholding types, multiple line taxes, and complete settings CRUD remain open.

web.gap: Open catalogue and multi-tax paths are not covered.

mobile.gap: Native tax settings and multi-tax workflows are absent.

coreCapabilities.title: Currencies and localization
coreCapabilities.gap: No managed currency catalogue, exchange rates, base-currency accounting, locale settings, or financial-year configuration exists.

contract.gap: Currency and locale contracts are missing.

api.gap: Currency accounting integration tests are missing.

web.gap: Currency and locale E2E is missing.

mobile.gap: Currency and locale tests are missing.

coreCapabilities.title: Company settings
coreCapabilities.gap: Email templates, schedules, communication defaults, currencies, and localization remain open.

web.gap: No complete settings E2E exists.

mobile.gap: Communication, currency, and locale settings are absent.

coreCapabilities.title: Companies/organisations
coreCapabilities.gap: Organisation CRUD, archive, switching, membership administration, and multiple-company UX are missing.

contract.gap: Only current-session organisation binding is covered.

api.gap: Organisation lifecycle and switching are missing.

web.gap: Multiple-company E2E is missing.

mobile.gap: Multiple-company workflow tests are missing.

coreCapabilities.title: Users and permissions
coreCapabilities.gap: Invitations, membership administration, role catalogue, and server action authorization are missing.

contract.gap: Invitation and permission contracts are missing.

api.gap: Session ownership exists, but role enforcement tests are missing.

web.gap: Team administration E2E is missing.

mobile.gap: Team administration tests are missing.

coreCapabilities.title: Customer portal
coreCapabilities.gap: Customers cannot authenticate, manage profiles, or list invoices, statements, payments, and receipts.

contract.gap: Portal identity and resource contracts are missing.

api.gap: Public share tokens exist, but authenticated portal authorization is missing.

web.gap: Public sharing is not an authenticated portal.

mobile.gap: Public sharing is not an authenticated portal.

coreCapabilities.title: Attachments/uploads
coreCapabilities.gap: Object storage is not consistently linked and authorized across invoices, bills, items, contacts, and transactions.

web.gap: Cross-domain attachment workflows are absent.

mobile.gap: Cross-domain attachment workflow tests are missing.

coreCapabilities.title: Import/export
coreCapabilities.gap: Most core domains lack previewable, idempotent import and lossless export.

contract.gap: Only bank and item schemas cover data mobility.

web.gap: Domain-wide round trips are missing.

mobile.gap: Native data-mobility workflows are missing.

coreCapabilities.title: Search, bulk actions, notifications
coreCapabilities.gap: No cross-domain search, reusable server bulk-action model, or persistent notification centre exists.

contract.gap: Search, bulk-action, and notification contracts are missing.

web.gap: Cross-domain E2E is missing.

mobile.gap: Cross-domain workflow tests are missing.

coreCapabilities.title: External API and API keys
coreCapabilities.gap: No API-key lifecycle, scoped external API, OpenAPI publication, or webhook delivery exists.

contract.gap: External API contracts and OpenAPI output are missing.

api.gap: API-key and webhook integration tests are missing.

web.gap: API-key administration E2E is missing.

mobile.reason: Human-facing mobile apps must not carry external API keys.

coreCapabilities.title: Mobile coverage
coreCapabilities.gap: Transfers, reconciliation, reporting, team administration, portal, and several accounting workflows are absent or lack authenticated-device proof.

contract.reason: Mobile consumes the domain contracts recorded by each capability.

api.reason: Mobile consumes the same Hono APIs recorded by each capability.

web.reason: This row measures the native client.

mobile.gap: The missing native workflows and authenticated-device proof remain open.

extensions.title: First-party module catalogue
extensions.decision: Catalogue decisions are planned but do not block core parity.

extensions.title: Estimates and quotes
extensions.decision: Implemented as the shared quote and estimate slice; it remains outside the core gate.

extensions.title: Automated bank feeds
extensions.decision: Requires a provider and architecture exception decision.

extensions.title: Connector framework
extensions.decision: Requires named integration approvals and certification.
